correctness.rationale: An explicit exhaustive classification of all 3^8=6561 complement-compatible four-bit edge supports yields exactly 20 nonempty strongly connected supports, six maximal and the precise two exceptional constant loops. The standalone standard-library checker computes this census, all six exact 8x8 determinant identities and traces, and independently checks each cyclic word of lengths 1..16. Strongly connected edge-support necessity and trace identities turn these finite exact facts into an all-n proof; finite checks alone are not used to extrapolate.

value.rationale: The first nontrivial (length-four) periodic complementary-factor restriction admits an unexpectedly small six-family renewal decomposition. Exact all-length binary necklace counts, periodic zeta and exponential growth follow from the six-support classification, giving natural symbolic-dynamics invariants not present in the motivating repetition-threshold work. This is not merely a low-n table or a restatement of the graph model.
